no_adcom_quote.quote: An advisory committee was not held for this application.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the DOJOLVI (triheptanoin) NDA; the Integrated Review's Advisory Committee Summary states plainly that 'An advisory committee was not held for this application.' The review documents describe internal FDA deliberations (the Medical Policy and Program Review Council, MPPRC) and note that the Sponsor requested an Advisory Committee meeting to discuss the impact of dietary changes in Study UX007-CL201, but no such committee meeting took place. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee concern-to-change linkages to report.
